source_primary.name: WHO Global Health Estimates 2021: disease burden (DALYs) by cause and country
source_primary.notes: Pulled from the WHO public API (https://xmart-api-public.who.int/DEX_CMS/GHE_FULL_DD), all ages, both sexes, the same data behind data.who.int country pages. Ranked items are WHO 'rankable' causes ordered by total DALYs. COVID-19 is excluded as a ranked item because 2021 is pandemic-distorted. Low-acuity, disability-only causes (back and neck pain, hearing loss, skin diseases, refractive errors, oral conditions, gynecological diseases, migraine, anxiety) are skipped so the list holds serious conditions; depression and self-harm are kept. Priority items come from WHO TB, malaria, HIV, hypertension and maternal mortality series (WHO GHO API and the WHO Global TB Programme estimates), IARC GLOBOCAN, PAHO, CDC and national surveys; each carries its own source_url. Known conflict: WHO GHE assigns dengue very few DALYs (rank 59 or lower in PHL, VNM, THA, DOM), while national surveillance shows very large case and hospital loads, so dengue is added as a priority item where surveillance supports it. Supplementary series use later years (TB 2024, malaria 2024, HIV 2025 (Philippines trend to 2024), maternal mortality 2023, hypertension 2019) than GHE 2021. IHME GBD 2021 was not used; its cause list and methods differ, so ranks can differ from these. Ranked items whose 'why' adds a TB, HIV or malaria figure draw it from https://www.who.int/teams/global-programme-on-tuberculosis-and-lung-health/data, https://www.who.int/data/gho/data/themes/hiv-aids and https://www.who.int/data/gho/data/indicators/indicator-details/GHO/estimated-number-of-malaria-cases.

countries.name: United States (including Puerto Rico)
countries.source_note: WHO GHE 2021, all ages, both sexes. COVID-19 removed from ranking (it would have been #1 by DALYs, 8.0% of all DALYs). Skipped as low-acuity, disability-only causes: back and neck pain (#3), anxiety disorders (#11). Ranks in 'why' are WHO ranks among rankable causes with COVID-19 removed; 'rank' is list position. WHO GHE covers the 50 states only; Puerto Rico is not a WHO member state and has no separate GHE estimate, so Puerto Rico appears through the CDC-sourced dengue priority item.
